# ComboChart

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Renders mixed bar, area, and line series on primary and optional secondary Y axes.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `CartesianChartBase`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new ComboChart()
new ComboChart(ChartData data)
```

## Properties

- [`BarStyle`](#barstyle): Corner rounding and gradient style applied to bar series.
- [`BarWidthRatio`](#barwidthratio): Fraction of each category slot occupied by bar series (0 to 1).
- [`GroupGapRatio`](#groupgapratio): Relative gap between grouped bar series within a category (0 to 1).
- [`SecondaryYAxis`](#secondaryyaxis): Optional right-hand secondary Y axis options for series bound to `secondary`.
